reward_table.$comment: kind/draws/condition decode RewardTBL.Unkn1/Unkn2; see mhfu-extract's README, 'Reward tables'.

kind.$comment: main: the main reward pool (Unkn1 0x8000). extra: a fixed extra reward, one draw (0x8001). conditional: awarded on a condition kept raw in 'condition'.

draws.$comment: Times the table is drawn. For main tables this is the base count before Luck skills, inferred from Unkn2's high byte. Null where unknown (conditional tables).

condition.$comment: Raw RewardTBL.Unkn1 of a conditional table, undecoded. Null for main and extra tables.

monster_size.$comment: The size, in percent, the quest's large monsters roll; see mhfu-extract's src/monsters/sizes.ts. 'modifier' is the header's MonSizeModifier, the centre of the roll; 'min' and 'max' bound it after the header's size variation (u8 at 0x4a). Monsters without crowns are always 100. 'fixed_until_flag': the monsters stay at 'modifier' until this save flag is set (likely the quest's first clear).

monster.description: Monster ID (emID); its name is in data/strings

alias.description: Named by the monster's n-th English alias (the game's own spelling), as the site showed it

crown_chances.$comment: The chance (0-1) this monster rolls a mini, silver or gold crown size in the quest; silver counts only sizes short of gold. Absent for monsters without crowns, which are always 100. For quests with monster_size.fixed_until_flag, the chance once the flag is set. See mhfu-extract's src/monsters/sizes.ts crownChances.

multipliers.$comment: The quest's stat multipliers for this monster, picked by the monster's multiplier set, the quest's stat table and 'power'; see mhfu-extract's src/monsters/multipliers.ts. HP is the monster's base_hp times 'hp', rounded down. 'defense' scales damage taken (lower: tougher). 'status' scales the parts' flinch thresholds. Furious Rajang's attack and defense are scaled again at run time.

monster.description: Monster ID (emID); its name is in data/strings

alias.description: Named by the monster's n-th English alias (the game's own spelling), as the site showed it

max_quantity.$comment: The most of this species in any single zone.

total_quantity.$comment: All of this species across the quest's zones; zone tables that share an address are counted once.

endless.$comment: A spawn of this species is marked 99, the game's value for one that keeps coming; those spawns are not in the counts.

monster.description: Monster ID (emID); its name is in data/strings

alias.description: Named by the monster's n-th English alias (the game's own spelling), as the site showed it

quest.$comment: The quest's text (title, goal, details, fail, client) is in data/strings, keyed by quest ID: extracted verbatim from the disc, English on the EU disc. See mhfu-extract's README.

map.description: Map ID, as in the quest header; its name is in data/strings

monster_size.$comment: null when the quest has no large monsters.

requires.$comment: ID of the quest that must be cleared before this one appears. Not on the disc: hand-entered in mhfu-extract's src/tables/quest-prerequisites.ts. Null when there is none or none is known.

urgent.$comment: An Urgent Quest, which unlocks the next star level. Not decoded from the disc: hand-entered in mhfu-extract's src/tables/urgent-quests.ts.
